basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Fort St. John, Canada, who recently stumbled into the world of Reddit. I love exploring new gadgets and figuring out how to optimize them, although I'm still learning the ropes. During the day, I work as a junior IT technician, and by night, I enjoy swing dancing and watching scandalous TV dramas. I'm single and spend most of my weekends cycling around town on my Super73. My online hours are typically in the evenings, after 7 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of IT systems, primarily through on-the-job experience and a few online courses. I enjoy tinkering with hardware and software settings to get the most out of my devices, though I often need guidance from more experienced users.
